headline: r13 at 0x1e0cd2c is loaded from the stack slot sp+24 (assigned at 0x1e0baa0). The same slot is used as the packed word whose bits 8/9 seed LT/RT in the sibling blocks, and the sibling block masks it with 0xffffff - so the value carries a low-24-bit pointer/field plus a high byte whose nibbles are the injector mode ids. The copy source is therefore a STRUCTURE REFERENCED BY sp+24, not a raw register.

r13.so_the_object_is: whatever is stored in the stack slot sp+24 of function 0x1e0aff2; the slot is read, never defined, in the blocks examined so far
dual_use: at 0x1e0cd2c r13 is passed as the SOURCE POINTER of a 28-byte copy into the candidate
at 0x1e0da52/0x1e0e3ac r13 is OR-ed with a mask and bits 8 and 9 are extracted as the LT and RT seeds
at 0x1e0e374 r13 is masked with 0xffffff, i.e. the value is treated as address + tag, which is why the mode byte comes from r2 = r0 >> 0x18
r13.linked_branch: 0x1e0cd1e: r0 = b[r8+0x20] | b[r15+0x10] ; if ((r0 & 0xff) == 0) goto 0x1e0c6a6 - the whole-struct copy is reached only when that OR is non-zero, so the copy is gated and is NOT an unconditional step in a single linear timeline
